title: 1993 FZJ80 Cummins 5.9 12v Swap
transmission: Stock 80-series gearbox with commercial adapter kit and 1989-05-spec flexplate/adapter plate
ai_summary: Owner of a Japanese-market 1993 FZJ80 is installing a Cummins 5.9L 12-valve pulled from a 1998 Dodge 2500 (190k miles), using a commercial adapter kit from a vendor called Dustin's. As of the thread's last update the build was mid-progress with engine prep underway; no post-swap performance data was reported.

complications.detail: Steering column clearance required fabricating a drop-down brace, with sections cut and re-welded
Fuel pickup tube stability was a concern; forum members recommended hose clamps over the stock pinch clamps, and custom alignment tooling was needed to mate the transmission
Firewall/tunnel clearance was addressed via consideration of a 1-inch body lift
